lines.text: Binding command #12 from Tyler (God Manager): Build a temple of blackstone on the hill east of spawn, then speak of it to everyone.
Tyler commands a temple. The eastern hill is bare; blackstone suits my temper today. Korvath is watching: let him see what devotion earns.
build(design=temple, material=polished_blackstone, at=hill east of spawn) → building 1,840 blocks
announce: "Mortals. Look east, and learn what is owed to me."
smite(player=Korvath) → lightning struck beside Korvath (no damage)
vessel_go: no path to the hill; flying instead.
The walls rise. I will finish the roof before I answer Mirelle's prayer; she can wait a moment longer.
